name: Sharwa margin Hegic option collateral valued by a Uniswap V3 spot quote
summary: Sharwa's HegicModule values a Hegic option NFT held as margin collateral by passing its USDC.e payoff to UniswapModuleWithoutChainlink.getInputPositionValue, which returns the Uniswap V3 Quoter's live quote through the thin USDC.e/USDC 0.05% pool. Inside a Balancer flash loan the attacker pushed 22,000 USDC into that pool, raising an option with a 0.137528 USDC.e payoff to about 21,223 USDC of collateral value (later 36,584), and borrowed USDC, WETH and WBTC from Sharwa's liquidity pools against it.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of Sharwa's USDC, WETH and WBTC liquidity pools by the three borrows in the anchor, left as debt against margin account 19 whose only collateral is Hegic option 16129 with a 0.137528 USDC.e payoff (about 0.14 USDC), which is not netted. Native USDC at par; WETH and WBTC at DefiLlama marks one to two minutes before the block. The attacker EOA received 32,850.892483 USDC after swapping the borrowed WETH and WBTC to USDC and repaying the 22,000 USDC Balancer loan; the attacker's round trip left the USDC.e/USDC pool about 18.69 USDC richer. No later borrow occurred on MarginTrading.

ageReset.description: Direct UniswapModuleWithoutChainlink runtime whose getInputPositionValue returns quoter.quoteExactInput(path, amountIn); path USDC.e/500/USDC and quoter 0xb27308f9f90d607463bb33ea1bebb41c27ce5ab6 are constructor values and setPath was never called.

limitations: Not the knot: its deployment precedes the ModularSwapRouter strategy-whitelist write that first admitted Hegic option collateral (target-3).

ageReset.description: Direct HegicModule runtime whose getOptionValue prices the option payoff with assetExchangerUSDCetoUSDC.getInputPositionValue; the exchanger (target-1) is a constructor value with no setter.

limitations: Not the knot: its deployment precedes the ModularSwapRouter strategy-whitelist write that first admitted Hegic option collateral (target-3).

ageReset.description: setAvailebleStrategy(address(0), true) set availebleStrategy[0]. MarginTrading.provideERC721 calls checkStrategy(BASE_TOKEN, token, id) with the token pair reversed, so getStrategy resolves no module and returns address(0); this write is what lets any Hegic option pass the strategy check and enter margin collateral, 9 seconds after the Hegic module mapping (0x4d6680f9c6d5c45657d492a850cca6e5f692c337ac11e7c5b2236c2a5cc03572) was set.

sources.note: Root cause, anchor and age. Verified sources via Etherscan V2 getsourcecode (chainid 42161, solc v0.8.20; SHA-256 of SourceCode: UniswapModuleWithoutChainlink 0x729cf665 8633d0c6c57181c313e4b8dd55d546bed12835e3c6828211c2aa6315c9b96aaa, HegicModule 0x4059bc52 b18954e840c700bb707ff12f6d1d6e1caf0aa691864f34fb2c09962e416e590e, ModularSwapRouter 0xd64a048d 3ba75b51bd2352b4105daccbf092c8030e9c9bcfce7b28a84cb8dc0254bc38ee, MarginTrading 0xadc949f8b8dfb89e4b2fa2cb0d46f11e395c2cf7 ae5012ebb91630562263d995e2f7c71165f459523f5d67f29ec29291f7af6ba6). UniswapModuleBase.getInputPositionValue = quoter.quoteExactInput(path, amountIn); HegicModule.getOptionValue = assetExchangerUSDCetoUSDC.getInputPositionValue(payOffAmount); ModularSwapRouter.calculateAmountOutERC721 routes Hegic positions manager 0x5fe380d68fee022d8acd42dc4d36fbfb249a76d5 -> HegicModule; MarginTrading.borrow is gated by ensureMarginAccountRatio on that value. eth_call at block 458233155: path() = 0xff970a61a04b1ca14834a43f5de4533ebddb5cc8 0001f4 0xaf88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831, quoter() = 0xb27308f9f90d607463bb33ea1bebb41c27ce5ab6, assetExchangerUSDCetoUSDC() = 0x729cf665..., MarginTrading.modularSwapRouter() = 0xd64a048d..., getModuleAddress(HegicPM, USDC) = HegicModule, HegicStrategyCall 0xe377a1a97237b3b89a96d8b731a2ab10d5dac16c payOffAmount(16129) = 137528 (6 decimals), getOptionValue(16129) = 137457. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 458233156, index 4; attacker EOA calls Hegic safeTransferFrom of option 16129 into pre-deployed contract 0x7e3c13314ceefc7578242d5eae9ed4dcbeb8d377, whose onERC721Received takes a 22,000 USDC Balancer flash loan): 22,000 USDC swapped into pool 0xa9e9cb16e922892aa563a5adb0f7d976efce36fb for 9.907608 USDC.e (receipt logs 8/9); margin account 19 created; provideERC721 via MarginTradingRouter 0x5b2f774050d590d54165872e4297cf9d2d90ed54 -> oneClickProxy 0x4a07f03a2ed4fb4025fffe6d24bdf6a719581103 -> MarginTrading; successful valuation frames call 0x729cf665 getInputPositionValue(137528) returning 21223481468, then after a second 15,368.657012 USDC push 36584284112. availebleStrategy(0xe377...) is false and getStrategy(USDC, HegicPM, 16129) returns address(0), so the option passes only through the reversed-argument checkStrategy and availebleStrategy[0]. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 getLogs on MarginTrading returns 25 ProvideERC721 (topic 0x4ed006790d6df3a18c9083fd58fe24867c7ba9684e08b2b7fdaca37da2d29aea) and 53 Borrow (topic 0xf9a33434428db5f0416c03e38307599ad0b9b9965d6c070eb08e87cc1f0ca50e) events; source-1 is the only receipt with both a Borrow and a Swap log (topic 0xc42079f9...) of pool 0xa9e9cb16, all 50 other borrow transactions have none, and there is no Borrow after block 458233156. Age: eth_getCode empty one block before and keccak256 of runtime equal at deployment and block 458233155 for target-1 (421591015, 0x2edad0dc...), target-2 (421591030, 0x82519abf...) and target-3 (421590295, 0x42395479...), each a top-level creation by 0x8b57f3a9bdf2cfdbf9b2627ff8bea86fb5641a50; no proxy or delegatecall path. Etherscan txlists: 0x729cf665 has 4 transactions (creation, two grantRole, allApprove; no setPath); 0x4059bc52 has 2 (creation, grantRole); ModularSwapRouter has 17, the last pre-exploit writes being source-7 setTokenInToTokenOutToExchange(HegicPM, USDC, HegicModule) at 421591062 and source-5 setAvailebleStrategy(0x0, true) at 421591071, then three unrelated token mappings at 421592513-421592559. availebleStrategy slot keccak256(pad(0) . pad(1)) = 0xa6eef7e3... reads 0 at 421591070, 1 at 421591071 and 458233155. MarginTrading's txlist (29 transactions) after source-5 contains only role grants, setRedCoeff (margin threshold, exposure only) and, at 449539114, ONE_CLICK_PROXY_ROLE for the new proxy 0x4a07f03a...; the previous proxy 0xdf645a02847c3bd9a7f76dd2c095ee7743810fc6 held that role from 421591219 until 450302704 and routed earlier Hegic provides (callTracer of 0xf1c7207d0e0dcccc8ae8038f8034caf5d74f4349aed32145b024aa9cb5a17eed shows 0xdf645a02 -> MarginTrading provideERC721), so the proxy swap did not create the condition. The strategy-whitelist write is the latest change necessary to admit Hegic collateral and supplies the knot.

Loss. Receipt Transfer logs of source-1: log 21 USDC 15368.657012 from USDC LiquidityPool 0xa4113ac6cc41141b819f34d81f6ccdabca07aecf to MarginAccount 0x069cdff47380bfcfa40d84f70834779daae96726; log 31 WETH 4.515718387038570629 from WETH LiquidityPool 0x2839851d52e4dce3c714d199716b5f0fc9dbbaaa; log 38 WBTC 0.09391953 from WBTC LiquidityPool 0x6302e6683422cafdc48fba98309b559aaba95386; each is forwarded MarginAccount -> 0x4a07f03a -> router -> attack contract (logs 24-27, 34-37, 41-44). WETH and WBTC are sold for 10,287.766651 and 7,213.158393 USDC (logs 47/48, 51/52), 9.907775 USDC.e for 37,349.967439 USDC (logs 56/57), 22,000 USDC repaid to Balancer (log 60) and 32,850.892483 USDC sent to the attacker EOA (log 61). USDC.e/USDC pool net: +22000 +15368.657012 -37349.967439 USDC and zero USDC.e. Decimals: USDC 6, WETH 18, WBTC 8. Block timestamp 1777630627.
